# Madwackd Studio

> AI video studio that turns ideas into finished video with voice: ads, trailers, music videos, explainers and social clips. A Madwackd Productions studio, headquartered in Denver, Colorado. Early access.

Key facts:
- A price estimate (seconds x model x takes) is shown before every render; each project has a budget cap; renders need prepaid credits; prompts the safety check blocks are never charged; technical failures with no video are refunded automatically; safety-blocked videos and unwanted takes are not refunded.
- Director's notes: feedback is rewritten into a clean, versioned prompt with a diff the user approves.
- Character Lock: an approved cast-sheet still starts every shot so faces stay consistent.
- Voice: stock voices, uploaded voices and in-browser recording, with a consent check for custom voices.
- Video model: third-party, generally available AI video models from a major cloud provider. Clips carry an invisible provenance mark.
- Pricing: Free account $0. Plans: Starter $29/mo (250 credits, about 10 clips), Pro $89/mo (900 credits, about 37 clips), Studio $299/mo (2,880 credits, about 120 clips). A clip is one 8-second Fast shot at 720p with sound. Test Drive $5 (50 credits, one per account). Credit packs: $14/100, $63/500, $115/1,000, $515/5,000. Done for you (quoted on a call): commercial spots from $2,500, music videos from $5,000, high-end commercials $20,000 to $30,000+. Madwackd Masterclass from $5,000, Masterclass+ $10,000, Mentorship from $25,000, all by application (education; results vary).
- Climate commitment: Madwackd Studio contributes 1.5% of its revenue to help advance permanent carbon removal, through Stripe Climate. Prepaid, priced-before-it-renders credits and spending caps avoid wasted compute. Details: https://www.madwackd.ai/our-mission/
- Contact: 1-800-481-8638, 1001 Bannock St #660, Denver, CO 80204. Parent studio: https://www.madwackd.com/

## Producer's Corner (guides)
- [Producer's Corner](https://www.madwackd.ai/producers-corner/): guides on video ads, commercial costs and AI music videos.
- [How much does a commercial cost to make? (2026)](https://www.madwackd.ai/producers-corner/how-much-does-a-commercial-cost/): sourced production and airtime ranges, cost drivers, and where AI fits.
- [How to make an AI music video: how we made ours](https://www.madwackd.ai/producers-corner/how-we-made-two-ai-music-videos/): the real process behind Tell Me Why and What Love Really Is.
- [Video ads for small business: a 7-step guide](https://www.madwackd.ai/producers-corner/video-ads-for-small-business/): length, the 3-second hook, one offer, honest AI labels, a 25-second script.

## Our best work
- Tell Me Why (country music video, 4:19) and What Love Really Is (neon cartoon music video, 5:01). Written and produced by Zach Wennstedt. A Madwackd Studio production. These are custom productions (many shots, retakes and a human edit), not one-prompt clips. Watch: https://www.madwackd.ai/vault/
